nodes.label: Tailwind Plus License (JavaScript Demo)
nodes.rationale: Grants Personal (one individual) or Team (up to 25 employees/contractors) rights to build unlimited End Products, but forbids redistributing components separately from an End Product or building anything competitive with Tailwind Plus. Governed by the laws of Ontario, Canada; liability capped at a refund of the license fee.

nodes.label: Personal License
nodes.rationale: Scoped to a single Licensee individual who may not share access; permits unlimited End Products for unlimited Clients including commercial SaaS and open-source projects.

nodes.label: Team License
nodes.rationale: Held by a business entity for up to 25 employees and contractors; adds the restriction that every End Product must be the sole property of the company or its clients, so staff cannot use the company license for side projects.

nodes.label: Non-Compete Redistribution Restriction
nodes.rationale: The core line is that components may not be re-distributed apart from an End Product, nor used to build website builders, starter kits, admin panel tools, or Figma/Sketch ports — anything letting an End User assemble their own products from the components would substitute for a Tailwind Plus purchase.
